correctness.rationale: For every binary p the greedy embedding in 0101... ends at e(p)=|p|+r(p)+first_bit(p); greediness proves minimality. For a palindrome adjacent equalities reflect, with a forced center equality at even length, giving binomial endpoint multiplicities and an exact formal geometric summation. An independent enumerator checks all palindromes in prefixes through 21; a different interval DP and a rational-series recurrence agree through prefix 150. These finite checks support but are not substituted for the all-length proof.

evidence: Mahalingam–Pandoh 2021 derives general upper bounds and a conjecture for total maximum; the known case of at least half as many alphabet symbols as word length does not cover long binary prefixes.
Holub–Saari 2009 reconstruction theorem does not imply the cardinalities stratified simultaneously by earliest embedding and palindrome length.
broader_coverage.reasoning: A general theorem proving each length-by-first-appearance count would subsume the new result. Examined broader published theorems concern scalar upper bounds or different length/maximality invariants, and no implication to the claimed refined coefficients follows. The global extremal conjecture is deliberately not asserted.

exact_database_or_table.reasoning: The univariate count and generating function are fully covered and excluded from the novelty claim. The known Fibonacci table shape does not coincide with the length-refined palindrome coefficient array (for example prefix length five gives 2,2,3,1,1, versus A204026 row 1,2,3,2,1). originality.rationale: Primary full-text comparisons show prior bounds and the extremal conjecture, but do not state the length-by-first-appearance enumeration. OEIS A238374 exactly precedes the scalar count and generating function: they are expressly excluded from originality. The new claim is the joint rational generating function and bijective binomial first-occurrence formulas. Different terminology elsewhere remains a real residual risk.
residual_risks: Equivalent length-refined enumeration could be present in work not indexed by search results or in sections of tangentially relevant literature not examined.
The exact scalar Fibonacci sequence and univariate rational generating function are already known in OEIS A238374; novelty is strictly confined to the first-occurrence-by-length refinement.
No independent external mathematical review has been performed.

value.rationale: The 2021 literature explicitly studies maximal distinct scattered-palindrome counts, for which alternating binary words provide the motivating canonical witness, but only total scalar counts were tabulated. This result determines every palindrome-length and earliest-prefix multiplicity for all lengths, and characterizes the exact length-2k threshold for covering the full k-palindrome language. Its natural bivariate first-occurrence invariant is not specified by the already-known scalar sequence. No global extremal theorem is needed or claimed.
